issue.title: Retire tool_failure_triage
issue.description: Agent-visible failure triage: the sase tool run footer shows labeled items and a verdict line, agent runs of stages: run_silent tools continue past all-KNOWN/FLAKY stages, and verify-monitor follow-ups include the triage section

task_type_fields.remove_when: The E3 epic lands with the precision backtest passing and the triage smoke group green
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The footer, the default continuation mode (never), and follow-up prompts are unchanged; triage is still recorded and visible through sase tool show and sase tool failures
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Agent-visible failure triage: the sase tool run footer shows labeled items and a verdict line, agent runs of stages: run_silent tools continue past all-KNOWN/FLAKY stages, and verify-monitor follow-ups include the triage section

payload.entry: Closed by sase-18j.land: tool_failure_triage was removed in 49c32e19ec (sase-18j.9) — registry member and definition, sase.schema.json entry, and every Off branch deleted; On branches (footer triage block + verdict, agent-default known continuation, follow-up Failure triage section) are unconditional. Verified at master 7512f4e9a1: no tool_failure_triage reference remains in src/, tests/, tools/, or docs/, and the lint (feature flags) stage passed in live run f1c9ad8815926dac689f98882dc4c192. The removal commit did not close this bead because sase-18j.9 was only authorized to close its own phase.
